attrs.note: datasheet - style, material (ABS, UL94V-0 on the product page), colour, the included fixings and the racks it matches are the specification table of the datasheet; RoHS and ISO 9001 its Standards Compliance list.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom is the top again: the side view draws the end fingers alike.

capacity.note: datasheet - the cable capacity table of the datasheet and of the Quick Start Guide V3.0 gives CMV-5U3W per cable type, theoretical values for reference only, with no fill stated. The figure stated is the Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm row.

chassis.note: drawing - WIDTH AND DEPTH SETTLED FROM THE DRAWING. FS prints the part two ways: the product page 222 x 26 x 84 (HxWxD), the datasheet table 222 x 84 x 25.3 with a "Rack System Width" of 3.0 in. The top view settles it: an L whose long arm is a finger, 84 (3 in) long and 11 thick (0.43 in), and whose short arm is the flange, 26 (1.02 in) across and 4.8 thick. The guide's step 3 puts the flange on the rail face and the fingers standing out of it, so the part is 26 wide across the rack's face, 222 high, and 84 deep, its outward projection - the product page's figures. The datasheet's 25.3 is no dimension on the drawing; it reads as the 26 of the flange.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black"; every image FS publishes of the part is a render.

front.note: drawing - the bracket from the front of the rack: the flange 26 wide, the spine and the six fingers end-on along its left edge, their caps in front. The figures are the side view's heights and the top view's widths.

guides.note: drawing - the duct on the front view is the column of fingers, run down the bracket; its finger pitch is the 44.4 between finger centres on the side view and its gap the 22.8 (0.9 in) between the middle fingers. Cables cross it through the gaps and run up and down beside it.

hand.note: estimated - the fingers stand along one edge of the flange, 3.6 to 14.6 of its 26 (the top view), and the guide's step 3 shows them at the outer edge of the left rail, with the screws inward of them. The bracket is drawn as it stands on the left rail, fingers at the left of its front; on the right rail it is the same part turned end over end, which nothing in a lab placement turns yet.

left.note: drawing - the side view of the datasheet, rear at x=0: the flange, the spine, the six fingers and their caps.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet (page 6) draws CMV-5U3W twice, a side view and a top view, in inches with millimetres in brackets. Measured on the embedded rasters at native size: the side view is 11.86 px/mm across its 84 and 11.85 down its 222, the top view 11.86 across the 84 and 11.88 across the 26 - all orthographic, good to a tenth of a millimetre. The renders of #64186 on the product page (64186.g6 straight-on from the side, 64186.g2 from behind, 64186.x2 dimensioned) are the second reading, and the Quick Start Guide V3.0 step 3 shows it fitted.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-face`. The Quick Start Guide V3.0 step 3 screws the bracket to the front of a rail with M6 screws and cage nuts (the product page: "for 2~3mm bracket ears thickness", so through the equipment's own ears), its flange flat on the rail and its fingers standing forward of it, on the left rail and on the right. It is narrower than the opening and stands at one rail's side of it, so a lab places it with a `side` (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md section 3.4); two on one unit, one each side, do not conflict. `ru: 5` is the rack units its 222 spans.

rear.note: drawing - the back of the flange, the face that lies on the rail: plain in the render from behind (64186.g2) apart from the comb of small tabs along the spine, which is not drawn. Mirrored, the spine is at the right.

rear-not-drawn.note: drawing - the comb of tabs along the back of the spine (64186.g2, and the guide's step 3), where the screws pass, is not drawn: no view dimensions it, and the fixing points are a gap.

right.note: drawing - the left view mirrored; nothing stands beyond the fingers on the right but the flange.

shell.note: drawing - an open comb, not a box: a sheet body (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4) whose six views are elevations. The solid is the flange as a well 79.2 deep on the front view, and the spine and the six fingers standing in it; the back of the flange is a plate sunk 0.05 inside the rear face.

thickness.note: drawing - 4.8, the flange on the top view (57 px at 11.86 px/mm).

top.note: drawing - the top view of the datasheet, rear at y=0: the flange 4.8 deep across the 26, the spine to 12.9 at its left edge, the topmost finger 11 thick from the spine to 80.3 and its cap to 84.
